LanguageData.MT_TurretBase.label: modular turret base (legacy ID)
LanguageData.MT_TurretBase.description: Normally, you should never see this object in regular play. Please avoid using it if at all possible. An existing modular turret base using its original saved identity. All bases now occupy 3×3. Completed footprint migrations are not repeated. An initial legacy conversion reserves obstacles by floor and keeps the current position when possible, or moves the base into vacant 3×3 space. Existing buildings, blueprints, rocks and compressed map data are preserved. If no placement is available, the same base and its construction objects are retained in off-map storage for an explicit placement retry. Installed parts, upgrades, work and ammunition remain on the same objects. New construction uses the current 3×3 modular turret base. Final combat destruction causes an explosion within an approximately 5×5 area. Entering wreck state or deconstruction does not explode.
LanguageData.MT_TurretBaseLarge.label: modular turret base
LanguageData.MT_TurretBaseLarge.description: A powered 3×3 automatic turret platform with replaceable main heads and auxiliary modules. Carry a manufactured part here and complete 100 construction work to install it. A main head is required to fire. The head and its attached modules rotate continuously toward targets. Main heads and modules can be upgraded through tier V; the base supports costly, repeatable damage, protection and range improvements. Final combat destruction causes an explosion within an approximately 5×5 area. Entering wreck state or deconstruction does not explode.
LanguageData.MT_AssemblyBench.label: turret assembly bench
LanguageData.MT_AssemblyBench.description: A precision workbench for manufacturing modular turret heads and auxiliary modules. Place a chair at its interaction spot for seated work. Nearby linked tool cabinets improve its work speed. Carry completed parts to a turret base for installation. Upgrade installed heads and modules at the base. Dual mortars use ordinary high-explosive shells; this workbench does not manufacture special ammunition.
LanguageData.MT_Module_FireControl.label: precision fire control module
LanguageData.MT_Module_FireControl.description: An aiming and friendly-fire protection module. Assembly management and item details show effects for the current turret and combat system. The upgrade tier is retained after removal. Aggressive mental states, spreading fire and collapses are excluded from protection.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Autocannon.label: autocannon head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Autocannon.description: A replaceable autocannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Sniper.label: sniper cannon head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Sniper.description: A replaceable sniper cannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.
LanguageData.MT_Head_DualAutocannon.label: dual autocannon head
LanguageData.MT_Head_DualAutocannon.description: A replaceable dual autocannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.
LanguageData.MT_Head_DualSniper.label: dual sniper cannon head
LanguageData.MT_Head_DualSniper.description: A replaceable dual sniper cannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.
LanguageData.MT_Head_DualMortar.label: dual mortar head
LanguageData.MT_Head_DualMortar.description: An autonomous dual mortar upper assembly using physical shells. Mounted effects and upgrade details follow the active combat system.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Flamethrower.label: flamethrower head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Flamethrower.description: Flamethrower upper assembly. Craft it at the turret assembly bench and carry it to a base for 100 construction work. Fires across a forward 90-degree cone with a base range of 6 cells. Eligible pawns, buildings, flammable plants and loose items in the cone take direct flame damage without accuracy misses, but walls block the attack. Ignites flammable scenery and loose items; the resulting ordinary fire keeps burning and can spread after firing stops. Fire control protects non-hostile faction pawns from direct shots except aggressive mental states; residual fire is not protected. Aiming, burst timing and cooldown still apply. Upgradeable from tier 0 to 5.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Minigun.label: minigun head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Minigun.description: A replaceable minigun main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Laser.label: laser cannon head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Laser.description: A replaceable laser cannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V. Fires a high-penetration single shot that applies damage without projectile travel time. Accuracy and cover checks still apply.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Missile.label: missile launcher head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Missile.description: A replaceable missile launcher main head. Fires eight missiles in rapid succession along spreading, curved paths. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Tesla.label: Tesla coil head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Tesla.description: A replaceable Tesla coil main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V. Base range is 5 cells. Each pulse hits living pawns and hostile buildings in range at once, through walls and without a miss roll. Pawns can take collateral damage regardless of faction; an installed fire-control module protects non-hostile faction pawns except aggressive mental states. It requires no aiming time or facing alignment; the post-shot cooldown still applies. Only left and right module slots are available.
LanguageData.MT_Head_Quantum.label: quantum cannon head
LanguageData.MT_Head_Quantum.description: A replaceable quantum cannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V. Applies instantaneous single-target damage through walls and roofs after normal aiming and burst intervals, without redirecting hits into cover. The small impact burst is visual only and causes no area damage. It fires at twice the minigun frequency. Friendly-fire protection requires a precision fire controller, as with other heads. It starts with higher weapon accuracy and gains further accuracy from head upgrades. A precision fire controller provides additional accuracy bonuses.
LanguageData.MT_Module_Range.label: range radar module
LanguageData.MT_Module_Range.description: Increases the range of the main and auxiliary weapons. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier. For multiple modules of this kind, use 100% of the strongest module's upgrade-effect value and 35% of each additional module's value when calculating the final stat. This also applies at tier 0.
LanguageData.MT_Module_Shield.label: shield module
LanguageData.MT_Module_Shield.description: Creates a recharging damage-absorption shield with a reset delay after it breaks. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier. For multiple modules of this kind, use 100% of the strongest module's upgrade-effect value and 35% of each additional module's value when calculating the final stat. This also applies at tier 0.
LanguageData.MT_Module_Auxiliary.label: auxiliary autocannon module
LanguageData.MT_Module_Auxiliary.description: A small autocannon with an independent firing cycle. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier.
LanguageData.MT_Module_Aiming.label: aiming assistant module
LanguageData.MT_Module_Aiming.description: Reduces aiming time for the main and auxiliary weapons. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier. For multiple modules of this kind, use 100% of the strongest module's upgrade-effect value and 35% of each additional module's value when calculating the final stat. This also applies at tier 0.
LanguageData.MT_Module_Cooling.label: coolant module
LanguageData.MT_Module_Cooling.description: Reduces the delay between bursts for the main and auxiliary weapons. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier. For multiple modules of this kind, use 100% of the strongest module's upgrade-effect value and 35% of each additional module's value when calculating the final stat. This also applies at tier 0.
LanguageData.MT_Module_Fan.label: tracking servo module
LanguageData.MT_Module_Fan.description: Accelerates turret target-tracking rotation. Tier 0/I/II/III/IV/V grants 1.125/1.25/1.5/2/3/5 times rotation speed. Duplicate copies use only the highest tier. Removing the module preserves its upgrade tier.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistAutocannon.label: autocannon fuse chamber module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistAutocannon.descripti: Replaces each round with an explosive impact of radius 1.4 cells. Targets take up to the round damage, with less damage toward the blast edge; no additional direct-hit damage is added. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the autocannon and dual autocannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistSniper.label: sniper penetrator core module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistSniper.description: Rounds continue through up to 3 targets along their flight path. Each further penetration retains 70% of the previous damage. Solid walls and shields stop the round. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the sniper cannon and dual sniper cannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistMinigun.label: minigun cycle drive module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistMinigun.description: Warmup and post-burst cooldown are reduced to 25% (1/4) of normal, while each burst also fires 25% (1/4) as many rounds (minimum 1). Time between rounds is unchanged. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the minigun. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistQuantum.label: quantum field stabilizer module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistQuantum.description: Sets the main weapon armor penetration to at least 100%. Higher penetration from upgrades is retained. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the quantum cannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistFlamethrower.label: flamethrower pressure regulator module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistFlamethrower.descrip: A flame hit has a 20% chance to make a living flesh target flee for up to 6 seconds; reaching safety may end it earlier. This temporary combat reaction does not affect targets already in a mental state, mechanoids or buildings. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the flamethrower. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistLaser.label: laser disruption optics module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistLaser.description: After dealing actual damage, a hit has a 20% chance to apply 50% of its base damage again to the struck body part. If the target survives, it also applies one secondary hit worth 25% of base damage to a valid torso or internal organ. Each extra hit still checks armor; fully absorbed primary hits trigger neither effect. This does not forcibly delete limbs. Fits the left, right or top slot only on the laser cannon. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistTesla.label: Tesla pulse capacitor module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistTesla.description: After dealing actual damage, pulses can stun each target for up to 2 seconds. A shared 5-second recovery period prevents repeated application by multiple turrets; normal stun immunity is retained. Fits only the left or right slot of a Tesla head. It is manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded. Only one copy of the same dedicated module may be installed or queued on a turret. Auxiliary weapons are unaffected. Installation and removal each require 100 construction work. Removal has the normal 1% failure chance.
